originalTestsChanged.test: F. a cycle among capacities is detected
originalTestsChanged.priorExpectation: two symmetric REQUIRES relationships form a cycle
originalTestsChanged.whyWrong: REQUIRES is a legal relationship the evaluator never follows; a symmetric pair is not a recursion
originalTestsChanged.replacement: a RULE_REFERENCE cycle is detected and fails closed; F2 asserts the symmetric legal pair is not a cycle

originalTestsChanged.test: a duplicate usage id makes the ledger unsafe rather than choosing a row
originalTestsChanged.whyWrong: one immutable identity may contribute at most once; the flag alone left a double count and AVAILABLE
originalTestsChanged.replacement: quarantine, DUPLICATE_LEDGER_USAGE_IDENTITY, status AMBIGUOUS, applied [], usage and remaining NOT_DETERMINED, forbidden amounts asserted

originalTestsChanged.test: a usage for another company / instrument / capacity is rejected
originalTestsChanged.priorExpectation: the rejection read from the per-capacity usageSelection
originalTestsChanged.whyWrong: that list existed only because every capacity rescanned the whole ledger (the quadratic source)
originalTestsChanged.replacement: scope rejections reported once in state.ledgerScope; a capacity's selection lists only records that could apply; never counted, reason stated, examined-once asserted

originalTestsChanged.test: ledger selection is indexed per capacity rather than rescanning for every pair
originalTestsChanged.whyWrong: encoded the double read the audit measured
originalTestsChanged.replacement: examined === n, applied === n, edgesVisited === n, cacheHits >= n
